Odisha CM Visits Flood-Hit Ganjam, Reviews Restoration Efforts

Odisha Chief Minister Majhi visited the flood-affected Ganjam district to inspect damaged paddy fields. The Principal Secretary of the Water Resources department also reviewed restoration works in the district.
